Definition: probably from G4535 (from the surge on the shore); Salamis, a place in Cyprus:--Salamis.
BiblicalUsage: Salamis is a city on Cyprus, where Paul and Barnabas preached. You find the name in Acts 13:5: "…at Salamis, they preached the word of God…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Salamis matters because God marks the places of his story, one by one. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
